t: Two things he praised women for
a: أَحْنَاهُ عَلَى وَلَدٍ فِي صِغَرِهِ وَأَرْعَاهُ عَلَى زَوْجٍ فِي ذَاتِ يَدِهِ
p: Aḥnāhu ʿalā waladin fī ṣigharih, wa arʿāhu ʿalā zawjin fī dhāti yadih
m: The most tender towards a child in its smallness, and the most careful over a husband in what his hand holds.
